facts.fact: The Data Protection Commission cited the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) as the law the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Parliament must continue to meet.
The Data Protection Commission is acting: it issued a statement on 20 October 2026 and keeps a register of data controllers.

The Data Protection Commission issued a public warning with protective measures on 20 October 2026 and announced a regulatory review of the disclosures; no decision against a named organisation is reported.
